name: vertov
description: Read Vertov screen recordings as transcripts and briefs, search your video library, and turn video files into share links.

interface.longDescription: Vertov is a screen recorder that gives every recording a share link, a transcript and a summary. Connect it to read any Vertov video you can see as a timestamped brief of what was shown and said, search your videos by what was said in them, write SOPs, bug reports and meeting notes from a recording, and upload a video file to get its share link. You sign in with your Vertov account and choose one workspace. No tool deletes videos or changes who can see them.
